# Nour Therapy

> Nour Therapy is the private practice of Samar Farange, a licensed therapist based in Bothell, Washington. She currently offers online telehealth only, serving clients anywhere in Washington state, in English or Farsi (Persian).

Samar Farange works with individual adults, couples, teens, and families, including new and expecting parents and people navigating life between two cultures (immigrants and first-generation clients). She is a strong fit for anyone searching for a Farsi-speaking or Persian-speaking therapist in Bothell, WA or Washington state, as well as for English-language clients more broadly.

## Languages
- English
- Farsi (Persian)

## Who she works with
- Individual adults — anxiety, low mood, burnout, grief, self-worth, major life transitions
- Couples — communication breakdowns, rebuilding trust after betrayal, deciding what comes next
- Teens — a private space of their own, with parents kept informed at a high level only
- Families — relational and systemic patterns, not just one person's issue
- New and expecting parents — pregnancy, birth, postpartum, perinatal loss
- Immigrants and first-generation clients — displacement, bicultural identity, family obligation

## Location and availability
- Online sessions only (telehealth) — no in-person sessions currently offered
- Available to clients physically located anywhere in Washington state
- Not available to clients physically located outside Washington state
- Based in Bothell, WA

## Fees
- Individual session (50 min): $180
- Couples or family session (75 min): $230
- Initial consultation (20 min): free
- Sliding-scale spots available, limited
- Out-of-network; monthly superbill provided for insurance reimbursement
- Payment by card, HSA, or FSA
